utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sam, I’m double-checking the date because I’ve heard both Saturday at 10 and a possible move to Sunday at the community center; once that’s settled, I’ll match up tool lenders with Mara’s repair list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — I’ve only got Saturday at 10 for now, so let’s confirm the final time and place before I coordinate tools.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll keep Saturday at 10 as the working plan and wait for the final confirmation on the place. Once Mara’s list is set, I’ll match the tools and helpers.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate it. If you hear any repair drive updates, could you let me know?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course, Oren — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I’d appreciate that. I’m liable to mix up the details again, so your help really saves me.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Faye — I’m still piecing things together, but I’ve heard Saturday at 10 is the plan, with Gus bringing tools and helping with check-in. Do you know if Opal still needs bins or tables sorted?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 10 is what I’ve penciled in too, but I’m checking the school calendar before I send it to the parent list. I’m not sure about Opal’s bins or tables yet—could you ask her, and I’ll help spread the word once we know?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely, I’ll check with Opal about the bins and tables and circle back so you can share the right details with the parent list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I can sort a few supplies for a short while, then I’ll need to head out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’s perfect, Uli—thank you. If you can just group the supplies we already have and note anything obvious that’s missing, I’ll take it from there when I catch up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course — I’ll group what we have and jot down anything missing before I go.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Kira — I’ve got the repair drive set for Saturday at 10, starting with the fence panel and then the porch light. I’m still waiting to hear where Opal wants the drop-off bins, so I’m keeping the setup plan flexible for now.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Saturday at 10 is still confirmed, right? And you’re just waiting on Opal for the drop-off bins?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Saturday at 10 is still confirmed, and I’m just waiting on Opal for the drop-off bins.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Bo, I’m planning to bring the drill, screwdrivers, duct tape, and maybe a folding table Saturday at 10—do you need me there a little early to help set up?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Gus—hold Saturday morning at the community shed for now, but I’m still waiting on whether 10 is firm and what’s actually on the fix list. If it’s confirmed, I’ll holler whether we need you early with that table.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Bo — I’ll stay flexible and wait for your confirmation. Just let me know if you want me to bring the table or come early once the fix list is set.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves if that helps—just let me know the time window.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That helps a lot, Rey — thank you! We’re aiming for Saturday morning, roughly 9 to noon, and I’ll send the exact spot soon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Perfect — Saturday morning works for me. I’ll bring the duct tape and work gloves, and I’ll watch for the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We still need extension cords, labels, and one person to check folks in. If you can take one of those, I’ll put you down.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Put me down for check-in, Leo, and I’ll bring labels too; my current note has us at the community center on Sunday, but I’m still confirming the exact time with Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll put you down for check-in and labels. Sunday at the community center is the latest I have too—please tell me the time once Rosa confirms.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Rosa, I’m trying to lock down the repair drive details—do you know the firm end time, and are we still short on any supplies besides gloves and duct tape?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes—new details are Sunday at the community center, and we’ll wrap at 2 p.m. Besides gloves and duct tape, we could still use extension cords, labels, and a couple of sturdy sorting bins.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks—that helps a lot. I’ll note Sunday at the community center and 2 p.m., and I’ll see if we can round up extension cords, labels, and a few sturdy sorting bins.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great — I’ll keep nudging the others, and we’ll meet Saturday morning for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — Saturday morning works, and I may have missed any newer details. If there’s anything folks should bring, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll keep reminding everyone, and if we need folks to bring any tools or supplies, I’ll let you know before Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Cleo—can you also check for hinges, nails, and extension cords, and tell me what you actually find before Saturday at 10?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll check for hinges, nails, and extension cords, and I’ll tell you exactly what I find before Saturday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—please bring whatever you find to my porch by Friday evening so I can sort it before the drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — I’m still waiting on Mara to confirm the exact time and supply list, so please keep it tentative for now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Hana — I’ll keep telling folks it’s tentative and wait for Mara’s final details before I pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate you keeping it tentative. I’ll update you as soon as Mara confirms the time and supply list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, we’re still set for Saturday morning at 10 for the repair drive, and I’ll keep reminding everyone. If you remember any fixes we still need, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Vik — we still need extension cords, labels, and someone to check people in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll keep those on the list and remind everyone we still need extension cords, labels, and a check-in person for Saturday morning at 10.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Noah, I think the repair drive is Saturday at 10 by the community shed, but I might be mixing up the details again. If you remember what still needs fixing, could you remind me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think it’s still Saturday morning by the community shed, but I may be missing an update. I remember tools and a few hands for donation sorting, though—does that line up with what you heard?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That sounds about right to me, Noah—Saturday at 10 by the community shed, with tools and a few folks for the donation sorting, though I’m still a bit fuzzy on the rest.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I only caught the gist, so I don’t want to guess—can you send me the time and the quick fix list for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — the repair drive is Saturday at 10 by the community shed, and the quick fix list is the fence panel and porch light. I can also help track tools and check-ins if needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, that’s what I needed — Saturday at 10 by the community shed, fence panel and porch light. If you can track tools and check-ins too, that helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — I’ll wait for Mara’s confirmation on the exact date and repair list before I send anything out. Once I have it, I’ll share the details so we can line up the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good, Hana — once Mara confirms it, send me the date and repair list and I’ll help match up the tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Will do, Jules — I’ll hold off until Mara confirms, then I’ll send you the exact date and repair list so we’re matching tools to real needs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I’m happy to pass along repair-drive needs if you point me to the right person.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell — if you can, please point me to Cleo, and I can help with supplies or sorting.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rey — I’ll point you toward Cleo and let her know you’re available for supplies or sorting on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal — I’m just catching up on the repair drive. I’m happy to help a bit, but I’m still waiting on Mara’s exact list before I grab anything.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane — I’ve noted Sunday at the community center, and I’m still checking Mara’s exact list and the time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll plan to swing by once Mara confirms the list and time, and I can pitch in for a bit then.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Eli, I’m still checking the shed for a hammer, screws, tape, and gloves for the repair drive—do you know if we’re short on anything else?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds like the basics are covered for now. If you spot any extra gloves or a tape measure, bring them along, and let me know if anything else turns up so I can keep the plan tidy.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it, I’ll bring any extra gloves and a tape measure if I find one, and I’ll let you know what turns up in the shed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Mara — I’m set to bring the drill, screwdrivers, and duct tape; just send me the time once it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — I’ve got you down for the drill, screwdrivers, and duct tape. I’m still confirming the repair drive time and will send it your way as soon as it’s firm.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Mara — I’ll keep those tools by the door and wait for your update on the time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Rosa, I’ll still come by Sunday at the community center and sort supplies for a short while. Thank you for labeling things so I can be useful quickly.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — that’s a big help. I’ll see you Sunday at the community center, and I’ll have everything labeled for you.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Rosa. I’ll be there Sunday and do what I can for a little while.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pia, can you confirm Saturday at 10 a.m., and tell me exactly what supplies you can bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, Saturday at 10 a.m. is the only firm start I have; I’m still trying to confirm the end time. I can bring labels, a clipboard, and extra trash bags, but I’m still checking what else we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Pia—please bring the labels, clipboard, and trash bags. Can you also check if you can bring a drill, screwdrivers, duct tape, or any spare screws and hinges?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s what folks are saying, but I’d still wait for Rosa or Hana to confirm before counting on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That’s fair, Tess — I’ll hold off treating Saturday as locked until Rosa or Hana confirms it, and I’ll double-check the screwdriver, tape, and extra-hands need with them too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good thinking, Kira — I’ll keep my ear open too, and if I hear Rosa or Hana pin it down, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Faye, last I heard the repair drive still needs screwdrivers, packing tape, and a few extra hands to carry boxes or sort donations.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Ira—that helps. I’ve got Saturday at 10 a.m. penciled in, and once I confirm the school calendar I’ll let the other parents know we still need screwdrivers, packing tape, and a few extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds great, Faye — if I hear any more while I’m out, I’ll pass it along.
